speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help assess your chronic cough, weight loss, and weakness, I need to know: how long have these symptoms been present, and have you experienced any fever, night sweats, or chest pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 68-year-old male. The patient reports having a fever, cough, weakness, night sweats, and poor appetite persisting for 6 months. He has lost 7.5 kg (16.5 lb) over this period. No history of breathlessness, nasal discharge, nasal obstruction, palpitations, chest pain, or digestive symptoms. Released from prison 9 months ago after a 2-year sentence.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent release from prison and the presence of fever and night sweats, I need to ask: have you had any known exposure to tuberculosis, or did you receive a BCG vaccine in the past? Also, have you noticed any blood in your sputum?
